task:
Task: The rolling-window type in lib.rs returns its readings in the wrong order. Pushing 1 then 2 into a window of capacity 3 should give [1, 2], but it does not. A full window reports its readings correctly, so this only shows up before the window fills. Find the cause and fix it so the tests pass.

The change is verified by running: rustc --test --edition 2021 -o t_symptomatic.exe test.rs && ./t_symptomatic.exe
Make that command exit 0. Do not edit any test files.
